table.name: airlines
table.purpose: Lookup table of 12 US airlines, referenced by the flights table via airline id.

Abbreviation.name: airline_short_name
Abbreviation.description: Short/common brand name of the airline (e.g. 'USAir', 'JetBlue', 'Southwest').

Airline.name: airline_full_name
Airline.description: Full legal/marketing name of the airline (e.g. 'US Airways', 'JetBlue Airways').

Country.name: airline_country
Country.description: Home country of the airline; constant 'USA' for all 12 rows.

uid.name: airline_id
uid.description: Primary key; unique integer id (1-12) for each airline, referenced by flights.Airline.

table.name: airports
table.purpose: Reference/lookup table of airports (one row per airport), used by the flights table as source and destination airport. All airports are in the United States; codes appear to be IATA-style 3-letter codes. Only 100 airports are present, so coverage is partial (likely only airports used in the flights data).

AirportCode.name: airport_code
AirportCode.description: Primary key. 3-letter airport code (IATA-style, e.g. ABQ, APN). Referenced by flights.SourceAirport and flights.DestAirport.

AirportName.name: airport_name
AirportName.description: Name of the airport (e.g. 'Alpena County Regional', 'Adak Island Ns'). Values have trailing spaces; 'Municipal' repeats 12 times, suggesting some names are truncated or generic.

City.name: city
City.description: City where the airport is located (e.g. Alpena, Anchorage). Not unique — several airports share a city.

Country.name: country
Country.description: Country name; constant 'United States' (with trailing space) for all rows.

CountryAbbrev.name: country_abbrev
CountryAbbrev.description: Two-letter country code, 'US' in all rows; one row has a trailing space ('US '), indicating inconsistent padding.

table.name: flights
table.purpose: One row per flight: which airline operates it, its flight number, and the origin and destination airports (referenced by airport code).

Airline.name: airline_id
Airline.description: Identifier of the operating airline; references airlines.uid (e.g. 2=USAir, 4=Southwest, 8=JetBlue, 11=Allegiant, 12=Virgin). 12 distinct airlines, each with 100 flights.

DestAirport.name: destination_airport_code
DestAirport.description: Destination airport, given as a 3-letter IATA-style airport code (with a leading space) referencing airports.AirportCode (e.g. APN=Alpena County Regional).

FlightNo.name: flight_number
FlightNo.description: Airline flight number (integer, range 2–1535). Not unique in this table (same number can appear for different airlines/routes), so it identifies a flight only in combination with the airline.

SourceAirport.name: origin_airport_code
SourceAirport.description: Origin (departure) airport, given as a 3-letter IATA-style airport code (with a leading space) referencing airports.AirportCode.
